spec.title: Node to Node Wireless Traffic Speed

spec.rawSql:
SELECT bh.fetched_at,                                                                                                                                                                                                           
         COALESCE(p.name, bh.parent_ip) || ' <-> ' || COALESCE(c.name, bh.node_ip)                                                                                                                                                
           || ' via ' || bh.intf || '/' || bh.chan || ' (' || bh.state || ')' AS route,                                                                                                                                           
         bh.speed                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  FROM velop.backhaul bh                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  LEFT JOIN velop.node p ON p.snapshot_id = bh.snapshot_id AND p.ip = bh.parent_ip                                                                                                                                                
  LEFT JOIN velop.node c ON c.snapshot_id = bh.snapshot_id AND c.ip = bh.node_ip                                                                                                                                                  
  WHERE bh.chan <> 'wired'                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    AND velop.epoch_ms(bh.fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to}                                                                                                                                                               
  ORDER BY bh.fetched_at DESC;

SELECT bh.fetched_at,                                                                                                                                                                                                           
         COALESCE(p.name, bh.parent_ip) || ' <-> ' || COALESCE(c.name, bh.node_ip)                                                                                                                                                
           || ' via ' || bh.intf || '/' || bh.chan AS route,                                                                                                                                                                      
         velop.try_bigint(bh.rssi) AS rssi                                                                                                                                                                                        
  FROM velop.backhaul bh                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  LEFT JOIN velop.node p ON p.snapshot_id = bh.snapshot_id AND p.ip = bh.parent_ip                                                                                                                                                
  LEFT JOIN velop.node c ON c.snapshot_id = bh.snapshot_id AND c.ip = bh.node_ip                                                                                                                                                  
  WHERE bh.chan <> 'wired'                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    AND velop.epoch_ms(bh.fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to}                                                                                                                                                               
  ORDER BY bh.fetched_at DESC;

SELECT  fetched_at, target,loss_pct, rtt_min, rtt_avg, rtt_max
FROM "velop"."ping"
WHERE  $__timeFilter(fetched_at)

SELECT d.fetched_at                                              AS "time",                                                                                                                                                     
         COALESCE(NULLIF(d.friendly_name,''), NULLIF(d.name,''), d.mac) AS device,                                                                                                                                                
         w.rssi                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  FROM velop.device d                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  JOIN velop.wlan_client w                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    ON w.snapshot_id = d.snapshot_id                                                                                                                                                                                              
   AND lower(w.client_mac) = lower(d.mac)                                                                                                                                                                                         
  WHERE velop.epoch_ms(d.fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to}                                                                                                                                                                
  ORDER BY "time" ASC, device;

SELECT d.fetched_at AS "time",                                                                                                                                                                                                  
         CASE                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
           WHEN w.rssi >= -50 THEN 'Excellent'                                                                                                                                                                                    
           WHEN w.rssi >= -60 THEN 'Very good'                                                                                                                                                                                    
           WHEN w.rssi >= -67 THEN 'Good'                                                                                                                                                                                         
           WHEN w.rssi >= -70 THEN 'Marginal'                                                                                                                                                                                     
           ELSE 'Poor'                                                                                                                                                                                                            
         END        AS rssi_band,                                                                                                                                                                                                 
         count(*)   AS rssi_count                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  FROM velop.device d                                                                                                                                                                                                             
  JOIN velop.wlan_client w                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    ON w.snapshot_id = d.snapshot_id                                                                                                                                                                                              
   AND lower(w.client_mac) = lower(d.mac)                                                                                                                                                                                         
  WHERE velop.epoch_ms(d.fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to}                                                                                                                                                                
  GROUP BY d.fetched_at, rssi_band                                                                                                                                                                                                
  ORDER BY "time" ASC, rssi_band;

SELECT wc.fetched_at, wc.client_mac, wc.rssi                                                                                                                                                                                    
  FROM "velop"."wlan_client" wc                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  WHERE lower(wc.client_mac) IN (                                                                                                                                                                                                 
          SELECT DISTINCT lower(mac) FROM velop.device WHERE ip = '$ip'                                                                                                                                                           
        )                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  AND velop.epoch_ms(wc.fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to}                                                                                                                                                                 
  ORDER BY wc.fetched_at;

spec.title: Node to Node Wired Traffic Speed

spec.rawSql:
SELECT bh.fetched_at,                                                                                                                                                                                                           
         p.name || ' <-> ' || c.name || ' via ' || bh.intf || '/' || bh.chan AS route,                                                                                                                                            
         bh.speed                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  FROM "velop"."backhaul" bh                                                                                                                                                                                                      
     , "velop"."node" p                                                                                                                                                                                                           
     , "velop"."node" c                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  WHERE bh.chan = 'wired'                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  AND   velop.epoch_ms(bh.fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to}                                                                                                                                                               
  AND   bh.snapshot_id = p.snapshot_id                                                                                                                                                                                            
  AND   bh.snapshot_id = c.snapshot_id                                                                                                                                                                                            
  AND   bh.parent_ip = p.ip                                                                                                                                                                                                       
  AND   bh.node_ip = c.ip                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  ORDER BY bh.fetched_at DESC;

spec.title: Wired Backhaul Status
spec.description: Nodes that should be on Ethernet backhaul. Green = wired; orange = fell back to 5 GHz wireless (~150 Mbps, shares airtime); red = absent from the backhaul table. The expected-wired list lives in sql/grafana_wired_backhaul_postgres.sql; the matching alert is grafana/alerts/velop-wired-backhaul.yaml.

spec.rawSql:
WITH expected (node_mac, node) AS (VALUES
       ('C4411EEC4275', 'LINKSYS-Hall'),
       ('C4411EEC4888', 'LINKSYS_return1'),
       ('E89F804C57DF', 'LINKSYS-Return..')),
snaps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT snapshot_id, fetched_at FROM velop.system
  WHERE velop.epoch_ms(fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to}),
bh AS (
  SELECT snapshot_id, node_mac, chan, state FROM velop.backhaul
  WHERE velop.epoch_ms(fetched_at) BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to})
SELECT s.fetched_at AS time,
       e.node AS metric,
       (CASE WHEN b.node_mac IS NULL                    THEN 2
             WHEN b.chan = 'wired' AND b.state = 'up'  THEN 0
             ELSE 1 END)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS backhaul
FROM snaps s
CROSS JOIN expected e
LEFT JOIN bh b ON b.snapshot_id = s.snapshot_id AND b.node_mac = e.node_mac
ORDER BY 1;

spec.name: nodelist

spec.query:

  FROM velop.system                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  WHERE fetched_at > now() - interval '24 hours'                                                                                                                                                                                  
    AND source_node_name IS NOT NULL                                                                                                                                                                                              
  ORDER BY source_node_name;
